label: Compensation Benchmarking Analysis
description: Analyzes compensation data against market benchmarks. Identifies positions above/below market, pay equity considerations, and recommends adjustments within budget constraints.

guidedInputs.label: Current compensation data
guidedInputs.description: Provide anonymised compensation data. Use role titles and levels, not names.
guidedInputs.placeholder:
Role | Level | Base Salary (annual) | Bonus % | Other
Senior Compliance Manager | M4 | €95,000 | 15% | n/a
Compliance Manager | M3 | €75,000 | 10% | n/a
Compliance Analyst | A2 | €52,000 | 5% | n/a
...

guidedInputs.label: Market benchmark data (if available)
guidedInputs.description: Paste benchmark data from surveys (Mercer, Radford, Korn Ferry, etc.) or any comparable data. If you don't have benchmarks, describe the market and the module will use knowledge of typical ranges.
guidedInputs.placeholder:
e.g., Based on Mercer 2024 Nordic Financial Services survey:
Senior Compliance Manager (P50): €105,000; (P25): €92,000; (P75): €118,000
Compliance Manager (P50): €82,000; (P25): €72,000; (P75): €93,000
...

guidedInputs.label: Market and organisation context
guidedInputs.placeholder: e.g., Nordic financial services market (Stockholm, Helsinki). Mid-sized institution, not competing at top-of-market. Recent retention issues in Compliance. Budget available for adjustments is approximately €150,000 per year.
